steps.title: Prompt & text embedding
steps.description: A text description of the scene is converted into an embedding vector by a language model (often a T5-style transformer), capturing meaning rather than literal words.

steps.title: Reference frame
steps.description: Many pipelines first generate a single high-fidelity reference image using a text-to-image model, giving the system a visual anchor for character, lighting, and style.

steps.title: Latent compression
steps.description: Raw video is far too large to process pixel-by-pixel. A variational autoencoder compresses frames into a compact 'latent space' representation that keeps only the essential structure.

steps.title: Reverse diffusion
steps.description: The model starts from pure random noise and, guided by the text/image embeddings through cross-attention, gradually removes noise over many steps until a coherent sequence of latent frames emerges.

steps.title: Temporal consistency
steps.description: A transformer architecture tracks how objects, characters, and motion should evolve across frames so the video doesn't flicker or morph between shots.

steps.title: Decoding & upscaling
steps.description: The denoised latent frames are decoded back into full-resolution pixels, then often passed through a super-resolution module for sharper, broadcast-ready footage.
